quests.title: Hereafter: The Trail of Pervases

dialogue.t: *sigh* This place really is in a terrible state. The pillars are rotten, the planks are broken. At least the statue's still fine...
Why hasn't anyone come to fix this place...
What would you two like?

dialogue.sit: Three servings of Grilled Tiger Fish to go, please.

dialogue.t: You got it! Hang on for a moment, they'll be ready soon!
Three servings? One for you, one for Paimon... Who's the last one for?

dialogue.sit: I was thinking we could go see Pervases.

dialogue.t: You mean gave-us-the-Seven-Star-Lamps-and-Censer Pervases?
Huh, that's right. He did say that he missed the taste of Grilled Tiger Fish...
But isn't he gone now?

dialogue.sit: Even so, we can still pay our respects.

dialogue.t: Yeah, that makes sense. Let's go see him, then!
The last time that we met Pervases there, the temple was in a pretty sad state, and there were Treasure Hoarders in the area, too...
Let's hope that his statue hasn't been defaced...
Your three servings of Grilled Tiger Fish. Hold on to them, now!
Ooh, these smell so nice! C'mon, {NICKNAME}. Off to our next stop!
Why are you here?

dialogue.sit: Are you here to see Pervases as well?

dialogue.t: I was just passing through.
What are you two here for?
We're here to see Pervases!
...Aw, but this place is in as much of a mess as last time...
There's a temple here, and a statue, too... Why doesn't anyone come to maintain this place?

dialogue.sit: Perhaps this place has been forgotten.

dialogue.t: How could people forget something like this? The Yakshas are heroes who defended Liyue Harbor...
Xiao, are... are you angry?
No. The Yakshas did not perform their duty for any form of recognition.
...Eh, let's not talk about this stuff right now. Grilled Tiger Fish first!
Uh, and if you wanna have some, Xiao, we can give you half of our share each.
It's fine...
Help! Help me!
Huh? Did you hear that?
There. Someone's calling for help.
Eh!? What about the Grilled Tiger Fish? Paimon hasn't eaten yet!
Thank you, O mighty adeptus, thank you, mighty hero! ...Oh, what are the odds? We meet again.
You know us?
How could I forget you...
I'm Wang Ping'an! Don't you remember me?
Huh!? What? What "Starsnatcher"? ...Please, l—let's not bring that up, not in front of the adeptus...
I was just getting ready to make an offering at the temple of the Yaksha, Pervases.
But not long after I entered the mountains, I was set upon by those Treasure Hoarders... Thank you for saving me...
Wait a moment. What were you going to do at Pervases' temple?
Were you planning to do something bad to his statue?
No, no! I wouldn't dream of it!

dialogue.sit: Then what were you planning to do?

dialogue.t: I... I wanted to restore the temple.
My plan today was to closely examine the temple's current condition and arrange for the purchase of the appropriate materials.
I never expected to be targeted halfway by Treasure Hoarders and forced to flee.
But as I ran, I... lost my way. As for the rest, you know what happened.

dialogue.sit: Let's speak further at the temple.

dialogue.t: Right, this is hardly the place for conversation. Let's go to the temple first.
We'll speak there.
Go. I have other things to handle.
Eh? You're leaving already?
...And he's gone.
This temple is in a terrible state...
Alright, mister, where did you suddenly get the idea to come and fix this temple?
Heh... Well, that's a long story...
Back when I was pretending to be an adeptus, I gathered a lot of resources to help me keep up the act...
But remember how I swore to do good after that adeptus taught me a lesson? Well, after I returned, I was planning to destroy all those materials of mine.
But then I had a thought... Rather than destroying all this information, wouldn't it be better to write up my code of charlatanry and share it with others?
That way, I can help others to see through scams and cheaters...
To my surprise, the guidebook I wrote proved helpful to a lot of people. Even the Ministry of Civil Affairs said that it was very useful.
They even provided me with some additional scam countermeasures to add to the stuff that I'd written myself...
To that end, they paid me a pretty hefty sum.
Apart from that guidebook, I'm currently planning to write a book about the Vigilant Yaksha.
Its purpose, of course, is to share the stories of the Vigilant Yaksha with as many people as possible.
That way, I'll be able to put the folklore knowledge I possess to good use.
As for this temple to Pervases, I discovered it while I was compiling material for this second book.
I found sources saying that this temple was built by our forebears to remember the Yaksha, Pervases.
But I never expected to find the temple in such a state of disrepair...
When I returned and thought about it, I decided to fund the repair of this temple from my own pocket.
After all, I, too, was guided back to the right path by an adeptus.
I suppose repairing this temple can be considered atonement for my previous wrongdoings.
Hmm... sounds genuine enough...
What do you think, {NICKNAME}?

dialogue.sit: That said, you've tried to fool us before...

dialogue.t: What do you mean "kinda"? I AM being genuine! One hundred percent genuine!
*sigh* Oh, fine, think whatever you like.
If you don't trust me, then come back once work has started. You'll see.

quests.description: When you smell the aroma of Grilled Tiger Fish, you are suddenly reminded of someone who once helped you…
